subject: Fix garbage earliest-expiry read in vsetEstimatedEarliestExpiry RAX path (#3956)
reason: The fix touches only vsetEstimatedEarliestExpiry() in src/vset.c, and a repository-wide search shows that function has no callers outside its own declaration (src/vset.h:91) and the new unit test (src/unit/test_vset.cpp): the hash-field expiry paths (vsetRemoveExpired via hashTypeDeleteExpiredFields, fieldExpireScanCallback, dbReclaimExpiredFields) never consult it. No command reply, expiry decision, replication, or persistence behaviour differs between the parent and fixed builds, so no server-level scenario — compared sequence or fault — can reach the changed code.
